input.quote: (b) Licensee agrees to allow an independent Certified Public Accountant or other Audit Professional, (selected by mutual agreement) to audit and analyze appropriate accounting records to ensure compliance with all terms of this Agreement. Any such audit shall be permitted by Licensee within 30 days of Licensee's receipt of a written request of Licensor.
input.rationale: The audit right binds us as Licensee. Several elements already meet the preferred position: the auditor is an independent CPA/Audit Professional selected by mutual agreement, the audit is limited to accounting records (no system access on its face), a written request with a 30-day accommodation window applies, and p0064 puts cost on Licensor unless a discrepancy exceeds 5%. However, the clause contains no frequency limit, so Licensor could request audits repeatedly — unlimited audits fall short of both the preferred (once per 12 months) and fallback (once per year) positions on a material term and approach walk-away territory. Minimal redline adds a once-per-twelve-months cap plus business-hours timing, auditor confidentiality and express exclusion of system access; the acceptable notice and cost allocation are unchanged.

proposal.summary: Limit usage audits to once per 12 months, business hours, confidential auditor, no system access
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a once-per-twelve-months frequency cap, business-hours timing, an auditor confidentiality undertaking and confirmation that audits do not extend to our systems, consistent with our playbook position that audits be infrequent, notified and records-based. The existing 30-day written request and Licensor-borne cost (absent a 5% discrepancy) are acceptable and unchanged.

ops.oldText: Any such audit shall be permitted by Licensee within 30 days of Licensee's receipt of a written request of Licensor.
ops.newText: Any such audit shall be permitted by Licensee within 30 days of Licensee's receipt of a written request of Licensor, provided that Licensor shall not request more than one such audit in any twelve (12) month period, each such audit shall be conducted during normal business hours, shall be limited to the relevant accounting records and shall not include access to Licensee's systems or networks, and the auditor shall be bound by written obligations of confidentiality.
